name: Skill Development Training - 90 Days Residential Skill Development Training Programme

_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a dependent of the registered construction worker.
1. The applicant's age should be between 18-30 years old.
1. The applicant should have knowledge of Telugu, Hindi, and English language.
